description: Live probe on 2026-10-07 UTC: after loginSessionCancel, Mutation.loginSessionConsume returns HTTP 200 with code BAD_USER_INPUT and message `Login session <code> does not exist` (trace 724937980177422481), which the provider-wide BAD_USER_INPUT matcher classified as RailwayValidationError. loginSessionVerify returns false and loginSessionCancel returns true for the same missing session. Type the missing session as a field-scoped not-found error.

value.description: The login session does not exist: it was cancelled, consumed, or expired. Stop polling and start a new session.
